body:
<!-- Before completing this template, read:
https://docs.sympy.org/dev/contributing/pull-request-guidelines.html
Local source: doc/src/contributing/pull-request-guidelines.rst
Keep all section headings below. -->

#### References to other Issues or PRs

This is causing CI errors on all PRs:
https://github.com/sympy/sympy/actions/runs/43056018373/job/130645561865

#### Brief description of what is fixed or changed

Remove the checkconflict.yml workflow file. This workflow runs a script that checks all PRs to see if they are mergeable and adds a label indicating whether the PR has merge conflicts. It stopped working for some reason and I've decided that the fix is just to delete it.

I don't think that we need to explicitly labels PRs with merge conflicts with a label that says that they have merge conflicts (I don't think I've ever made use of as a feature).

Also I don't like that this workflow uses the risky `pull_request_target` event that has been exploited by hackers in other repos so removing it makes me a little happier about the security of CI.

Another change here is to fix a test that was recently added that fails on PyPy.

#### Other comments

#### AI Generation Disclosure

NO AI USE

#### Release Notes


<!-- BEGIN RELEASE NOTES -->
NO ENTRY
<!-- END RELEASE NOTES -->

diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/checkconflict.yml b/.github/workflows/checkconflict.yml
deleted file mode 100644
index 39ac103ebfbf..000000000000
--- a/.github/workflows/checkconflict.yml
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,32 +0,0 @@
-name: "Maintenance"
-on:
-  # So that PRs touching the same files as the push are updated
-  push:
-  # So that the `dirtyLabel` is removed if conflicts are resolve
-
-  # XXX: This workflow needs to update labels on fork PRs, so it uses the
-  # privileged pull_request_target event. Do not add checkout or shell steps
-  # that consume PR-controlled data here.
-
-  pull_request_target: # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers]
-    types: [synchronize]
-
-concurrency:
-  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
-  cancel-in-progress: true
-
-permissions: {}
-
-jobs:
-  main:
-    name: Check Merge Conflicts
-    permissions:
-      pull-requests: read # to check if PR is mergeable.
-      issues: write # to add and remove the merge-conflict label
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - name: Check if PRs have merge conflicts
-        uses: eps1lon/actions-label-merge-conflict@0273be72a0bbd58fcd71d0d6c02c209b50d1e5e1 # v3.1.0
-        with:
-          dirtyLabel: "Merge conflict"
-          repoToken: "${{ github.token }}"
diff --git a/release/compare_tar_against_git.py b/release/compare_tar_against_git.py
index 4ce381fd2915..83826994335e 100755
--- a/release/compare_tar_against_git.py
+++ b/release/compare_tar_against_git.py
@@ -36,7 +36,6 @@ def main(tarname, gitroot):
     '.github/workflows/runtests.yml',
     '.github/workflows/emscripten.yml',
     '.github/workflows/release.yml',
-    '.github/workflows/checkconflict.yml',
     '.github/workflows/nightly-wheels.yml',
     '.github/workflows/zizmor.yml',
     '.ci/durations.json',
diff --git a/sympy/core/tests/test_subs.py b/sympy/core/tests/test_subs.py
index 4d7d12c68cfd..d3f7f7215123 100644
--- a/sympy/core/tests/test_subs.py
+++ b/sympy/core/tests/test_subs.py
@@ -661,14 +661,13 @@ def test_aresame_identical_and_class():
     b1 = Basic(f1)
     b2 = Basic(f1)
 
-    assert f1 is not f2
     assert b1 is not b2
 
     assert _aresame(f1, f1)
-    assert not _aresame(f1, f2)
+    assert _aresame(f1, f2) == (f1 is f2)
     assert _aresame(b1, b1)
     assert _aresame(b1, b2)
-    assert not _aresame(b1, Basic(f2))
+    assert _aresame(b1, Basic(f2)) == (f1 is f2)
 
     assert not _aresame(f1, S.NaN)
     assert not _aresame(b1, Basic(S.NaN))

issue_comments.author: smichr
issue_comments.body:
Did you try change the `read` to `write`?
```
permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
```
ChatGPT notes, "I inspected the pinned action's TypeScript source. It queries GitHub's API and updates labels. It does not check out or execute contributor code."

issue_comments.author: oscarbenjamin
issue_comments.body:
> Did you try change the `read` to `write`?

No, but those things have not changed since 2 days ago when this started breaking. This workflow has never been particularly useful and I don't want to maintain it and I don't like the security risk.

I don't care what ChatGPT says about the pinned action: it is simpler and safer not to have any pull_request_target anywhere in CI.

title: fix(ci): remove CI job that checks PRs for merge conflicts
